target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
The 2023 disclosure defines the Platform Solutions segment, comprising Consumer Platforms (credit cards, POS financing) and Transaction Banking. The 2024 disclosures D102, D103, D104, and D195 collectively cover these same components: D102 defines the segment, D103 details Consumer Platforms, D104 details Transaction Banking, and D195 discusses the narrowing focus on these specific consumer activities. They all share the specific topic of the composition and definition of the Platform Solutions business lines.

Both disclosures address deposit composition within the Consumer platforms/Funding Sources topic. gs_2023_7_D116 explicitly states 'We also accept deposits from Apple Card customers' as part of Consumer platforms. gs_2024_7_D134 details that 'Consumer deposits consist of deposits from both Marcus and Apple Card customers' and provides FDIC/non-U.S. insured totals. While D134 includes additional FDIC data, the core topic of Consumer deposit sources (Marcus/Apple) links the two within Item 7.

previous_disclosures.summary: Platform Solutions comprises consumer platforms, such as credit card and point-of-sale financing partnerships, and transaction banking services including cash management and payment solutions for corporate and institutional clients.

current_disclosures.summary: The Platform Solutions segment includes consumer platforms and transaction banking and other services.
The Consumer platforms business issues credit cards and raises deposits from Apple Card customers, with revenues primarily consisting of net interest income earned on credit card lending activities.

The firm provides transaction banking and other services, including deposit-taking, payment solutions, and cash management services for corporate and institutional clients, with revenues including net interest income attributed to transaction banking deposits.

current_disclosures.section: Balance Sheet and Funding Sources > Funding Sources
current_disclosures.summary: Consumer deposits include Marcus and Apple Card customers, while FDIC-insured deposits were $234.54 billion as of December 2024 and non-U.S. insured deposits were $25.98 billion as of the same date.

current_disclosures.section: Regulatory and Other Matters > Other Matters > THE GOLDMAN SACHS GROUP, INC. AND SUBSIDIARIES
current_disclosures.summary: Goldman Sachs is narrowing its focus on consumer-related activities and retains two main consumer activities within Platform Solutions: issuing credit cards/deposits for the Apple Card and supporting the GM credit card program until transition to another issuer is complete.

comparisons.peer_topic: Services segment composition and product offerings
comparisons.peer_summary: The Services segment includes Treasury and Trade Solutions (TTS) and Securities Services. TTS provides cash management, payments, and trade solutions, while Securities Services connects clients to global markets with custody, administration, and data solutions.
comparisons.comparison: Both Goldman Sachs (GS) and Citigroup (C) define their segments to include 'Transaction Banking' or 'Treasury and Trade Solutions' (TTS), which provide cash management, payments, and trade services. GS describes Platform Solutions as including 'transaction banking and other,' while C's Services segment explicitly includes TTS which 'provides an integrated suite of tailored cash management, payments and trade and working capital solutions.'

sentences.text: Platform Solutions includes our consumer platforms and transaction banking and other.
Services includes Treasury and Trade Solutions (TTS) and Securities Services.
TTS provides an integrated suite of tailored cash management, payments and trade and working capital solutions to multinational corporations, financial institutions and public sector organizations.
